title: Peter Thiel on Stagnation, Innovation, and What Not To Name Your Company | Conversations with Tyler
summary: Tyler Cowen interviews Peter Thiel about technological stagnation, innovation, and lessons from Zero to One. The conversation ranges over business, startups and how Thiel thinks about progress.
why: HN people point to it as a strong interview and as the source of Thiel's stagnation thesis.

quote.text: it's an interview with Tyler Cowen who does a terrific job at interviewing Peter.
